instruction: Configure the GNOME window title bar buttons to display on the left side (close, minimize, maximize on left) instead of the default right side.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving window buttons to left side. Evaluator checks gsettings org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout contains 'close,minimize,maximize:' (buttons before colon are on left).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings command to retrieve GNOME window button layout configuration
